column1: # Ivan hears the Bloom: his lines in the Chapter 3 scenes.

column3: She enjoyed that, Isaac. I\ncould feel it. She wants us\nafraid.{end_wait}
I can hear them, Isaac. All\nof them. They're awake,\nand they're terrified.{end_wait}
No. It's getting louder. I\nthink it's what we lit.{end_wait}

Mia, I can hear them down
there. Some are praying,
and some are changing.{page_break}Every minute we argue,
there are fewer.{end_wait}
The blade went quiet when\nshe stopped. It wants her\nback, and it's patient.{end_wait}
